questions.question: 你需要在内存和功耗预算都很紧张的手机上运行一个约 3B 参数的语言模型。与在数据中心服务同一个模型相比，有哪些变化？
questions.questionEn: You need to run a ~3B-parameter language model on a phone with tight memory and power budgets. What changes versus serving the same model in a datacenter?

questions.questionEn: Explain post-training quantization versus quantization-aware training. What breaks when you push weights to 2–4 bits, and how do you recover quality?

questions.question: 你的端侧模型必须输出合法且符合 schema 的 tool call。你如何保证其合法性，而不是指望它碰巧正确？
questions.questionEn: Your on-device model must emit valid, schema-conforming tool calls. How do you guarantee validity rather than hope for it?

sources.title: LLM 中的 Function Calling 是如何工作的？

questions.question: 你只有一个端侧 base model，却要支撑十几个功能：摘要、改写、回复建议、语气调整。如何在不发布十几个模型的前提下完成特化？
questions.questionEn: You have one on-device base model but a dozen features: summarization, rewriting, reply suggestions, tone adjustment. How do you specialise without shipping a dozen models?

questions.question: 如何在不收集用户内容的前提下，利用用户设备上的信号来改进端侧模型？
questions.questionEn: How would you improve an on-device model using signals from user devices without collecting user content?

questions.question: 设计一个路由层，决定用户请求是由端侧处理、由第一方服务端模型处理，还是由第三方模型处理。
questions.questionEn: Design the routing layer that decides whether a user request is handled on-device, by a first-party server model, or by a third-party model.

sources.title: 云端部署 vs 端侧模型部署

questions.question: 用户说“把周六徒步的照片发给 Maya”。请设计从这句话到参数已解析的结构化 app action 的端侧链路。
questions.questionEn: A user says “send Maya the photos from Saturday's hike.” Design the on-device path from that utterance to a structured app action with resolved parameters.

sources.title: LLM 中的 Function Calling 是如何工作的？

questions.question: 你要向 30 多个语言区域的数亿用户上线通知摘要功能，而且不能记录用户内容。请设计评估与回归检测方案。
questions.questionEn: You're shipping notification summarization to hundreds of millions of users in 30+ locales, and you cannot log user content. Design the evaluation and regression-detection story.

questions.question: 请讲一次你在信息不完整的情况下推进工作的经历：当时你无法被告知自己所做工作的完整背景。
questions.questionEn: Tell me about a time you had to make progress with incomplete information: you couldn't be told the full context of what you were building.
